entities.summary: Marko Tkalec is a retired professional tennis player from Slovenia. He achieved a career-high singles ranking of World No. 243 in 2002. Tkalec has participated in 22 Davis Cup ties for Slovenia, posting a 25–9 record in singles and a 3–4 record in doubles. Marko Tkalec was a athletes & competitors from Maribor (b. 1977-03-17, Maribor). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
